items.t: After Plunging 34.1% in 4 Weeks, Here's Why the Trend Might Reverse for Lithium Americas Corp. (LAC)
items.sum: Lithium Americas Corp. (LAC) is technically in oversold territory now, so the heavy selling pressure might have exhausted. This along with strong agreement among Wall Street analysts in raising earnings estimates could lead to a trend reversal for the stock.

items.t: Inside the Army’s 75 Year Plan to Escape China’s Rare Earth Dominance
items.sum: In a bid to stimulate domestic rare earth processing, the US Army is trying something fundamentally different at its Tooele Army Depot: providing land and security while a private company finances, builds, and operates the facility

items.t: Shares of critical metal companies are trading lower after cooler-than-expected Chinese industrial production data signaled slowed output that impacts global prices. A global tech selloff has pressured copper, an energy conductor, as dollar strength rises alongside concerns about December rate hikes
